title: Only the routine Root Edit path is specified — non-routine conditions and expert review are empty placeholders
content:
The Root Edit Operational Process Definition declares three protocols: Routine (A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.1), Non-Routine (A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.2), and Emergency (A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.3). Only two carry substance. The Non-Routine Protocol says only that the documents herein "define the process for using the Root Edit Primitive to update the Launch Agent 7 Agent Artifact in non-routine conditions" — with no such process given, and no definition of what makes conditions non-routine.

Separately, A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.2 defers the expert layer: "A future iteration of the Launch Agent 7 Artifact will specify guidelines for obtaining specialized review of proposals requiring advanced technical or financial analysis."

Both gaps land on the same actor. With no non-routine path and no expert advisors, every proposal — including ones requiring advanced financial analysis of a structured-credit Agent — is reviewed inside seven days by the Operational Facilitator alone, and the only defined deviation from the routine timeline is the Emergency Protocol, which shortens rather than deepens review.

That is a notable mismatch for an Agent whose business is institutional credit facilities: proposal complexity is likely to exceed what a generalist alignment review can assess, and the mechanism intended to close that gap is explicitly not yet written.
